CustomField.label: Winning Opportunity
CustomField.description: The winner AFTER lead conversion. Written instead of Winning_Lead__c when the winning Lead is converted, because a lookup to a converted Lead is rejected by the platform (CANNOT_UPDATE_CONVERTED_LEAD). Exactly one of Winning_Lead__c / Winning_Opportunity__c is populated on any row.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The winning Opportunity this submission's history rolls up under, once the winning Lead has been converted.
